# 702.12. Indestructible (in 702. Keyword Abilities)

<!-- Generated by scripts/fetch-rules.mjs from the Comprehensive Rules effective November 6, 2026. Do not edit. -->

702.12. Indestructible

702.12a Indestructible is a static ability.

702.12b A permanent with indestructible can’t be destroyed. Such permanents aren’t destroyed by lethal damage, and they ignore the state-based action that checks for lethal damage (see rule 704.5g).

702.12c Multiple instances of indestructible on the same permanent are redundant.
